blocks.html:
Jewel Radio Car Full Wrap

Vinyl Wrap Toronto did this van wrap a little while ago and is still one of our favourites. This is the perfect example of a commercial full wrap. The customer, Jewel Radio, wanted to make a statement and an impact with this full wrap.

We wrapped the entire van and applied vinyl to the windows to complete the look. The colours the client chose were to help this vehicle to stand out anywhere. You would not be able to miss this driving down the road or motorway.

The pictures show some of the installation processes. Our team takes great care when doing the installation and makes sure you are happy with the final product. The vinyl wrap we use is only the highest quality material on the market today.

This Dodge Journey is almost unrecognizable with the full wrap done.
Come meet our installation team and our graphic designers at our garage, 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke. They will be more than happy to answer any questions. If you would like to learn more about Vinyl wraps or window tints. Click here to see more of our van wraps.
We also offer partial wraps and stickers or decals if you want to still advertise or brand your vehicle.

Price may be a factor when considering doing a wrap. Call one of our in-house design team or installation crew for a quote at 416-746-1381. Our installation crew will also recommend aftercare and answer any questions you may have. All this before you drive away in your shiny, looking like new, vehicle.
Vinyl Wrap Toronto also offers Wall graphics as you can see behind the van.

Follow us on Facebook and Instagram for more of our latest wraps.
